steps.text: 1/8  Connect — open Studio, paste the API token, click Connect
2/8  Overview — live runtime diagnostics and platform inventory
3/8  DEFINE — GoalSpec designer: templates are drafts, not validation
4/8  BUILD — Agent lifecycle: draft, validate, publish, sign, revoke
5/8  DISCOVER — MCP connections: tools/list inspection, never tools/call
6/8  DISCOVER — Tool registry & persisted discovery history
7/8  VERIFY — Audit timeline: load events, verify the hash chain
8/8  OPERATE & MANAGE — runtime diagnostics; unsupported data says UNAVAILABLE
